headline: Danantara Net Profit Margin 8.4%, ROE Reaches 8.7%
summary: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund BPI Danantara has released its 2025 financial results, with a net profit margin of 8.4% and return on equity of 8.7%.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's state investment holding entity that manages stakes in large state-owned companies, so its performance signals the health of a major state investment portfolio.
original_headline: Margin Laba Bersih Danantara 8,4%, ROE Tembus 8,7%
